get_water_levels.description: Read the water level measured at a tide station: the latest reading, today's, or any period you name. Choose the 6-minute series for the live gauge, the hourly series for verified history, or the 1-minute series for storm detail. Heights come back against the datum you pick, so they read the same way a tide table does. No API key required.

description: Read NOAA's tide and current data for the US coast: water levels from any of its gauges, tide predictions for 3,500 stations, tidal current predictions, wind, air and water temperature, pressure and visibility, bridge clearances, and the live board from every PORTS. It also covers the long view - sea level trends and rise projections, record and extreme water levels, and high tide flooding days, likelihoods and projections. No account or API key required.
